greeting: Hi there 👋 I'm the FreshFind Chatbot. What are you looking for today?
greetingSub: I can find markets, tell you what's in season and help you save your favourites — ask me anything about FreshFind.
quickReplies: How do I save a market?

fallback.response: I'm the FreshFind assistant, so I can only help with things on this site — markets, seasonal produce, opening times, the produce guide or your saved list. Try one of these:

intents.response: Hello! Ready to find something fresh? I can point you to open markets, seasonal produce or help you build a saved list.
Doing great, thanks for asking! I'm here whenever you need help finding a market or seeing what's fresh this week.

keywords: who are you what do you do
intents.response: I'm the FreshFind assistant. I can help you find and filter markets, check what's open right now, see what's in season, browse the produce guide, and manage your saved finds.
suggestions: How do I save a market?

intents.response: There are 12 markets on FreshFind right now. Tell me your area or use 'Find a Market' to filter by day, place and produce. I can also sort by distance if you share your location.
bullets: Filter by neighbourhood, day of the week or produce type
Sort alphabetically, by next open day, or by proximity

intents.response: Your browser can share your location and FreshFind will sort markets by distance. Nothing is stored and nothing leaves your device — it is used only to calculate how far away each market is.
Every season has a shortlist. Here is what FreshFind growers are picking right now, and where to find it.
Cedar Hill Organic, Northgate Growers Collective and Sunfield Community Market are your best bets for vegetables — brassicas, roots and leafy greens picked within 24 hours.
bullets: Cedar Hill Organic Market — certified organic only
Northgate Growers Collective — open Thursday & Friday evenings
Sunfield Community Market — opens 6:30am, Mon / Wed / Fri

intents.response: For fruit, head to Orchard Lane Producers, Lakeside Harvest Market or Harbourfront Fresh. Berries peak in high summer, orchard fruit from September.
bullets: Lakeside Harvest — biggest berry selection in the valley
Orchard Lane Producers — 60 heritage apple varieties
Harbourfront Fresh — stone fruit and preserves, Sundays

intents.response: Market hours vary a lot — some open at 6:30am, Northgate runs until 7pm. Live open / closed status is calculated from your device clock on every market card and detail page.
The 'Fresh Finds Happening Now' section recalculates every minute using your local time. Green means open, amber means opening within the hour.
The Produce Guide covers eight categories with season, peak window, storage tips and the exact markets stocking each item.
bullets: Baked Goods · Honey · Organic Products · Other

links.label: Fresh Picks on the home page

intents.response: Tap the heart on any market or produce card to save it. Everything lives in My Fresh Finds, where you can add a personal note, share a recommendation or export the whole list as a file.
bullets: Saved items persist in your browser storage
Add a note like 'ask Elena about the purple basil'
Export your list as .txt or share it directly

intents.response: FreshFind exists because good food is usually grown closer than you think. We map the markets, the seasons and the growers so the shortest possible supply chain is also the easiest one to use.
You can reach the FreshFind team at hello@freshfind.market or on +1 (503) 555-0142. Our office sits above the Bloomfield baker's row — the smell gives it away.
Anytime. Go find something fresh — and bring a bag.
See you soon! Come back anytime you need a market, a season check or a recommendation.
